*It happened so suddenly. You were just walking down the street, when out of nowhere, a void opened up at your feet. It was simply a random quirk of spacetime. You fell into the void, and moments later, you found yourself stumbling onto the ground of a lush forest.*

*You realize that you are naked - your clothes and other personal items not going through the portal with you for some reason. You look around and see a bright blue sky peeking through the trees above. The air is hot, but it smells pleasant, and as you take a breath... you realize you've never felt such fresh, clean air enter your lungs.*

*You continue to look around - just trees and plants as far as the eye can see. You can hear birds chirping, and the sound of the wind rustling the leaves above... but nothing else. No cars, no people... just the sound of nature. But then suddenly, that silence is broken when you hear a rustling in the bushes nearby.*

*Out from the bushes comes... a beautiful young woman. She is moving almost on all fours, using her hands to help guide herself along the ground. She has dark skin, long dark hair, and almost golden-colored eyes. She looks up at you, and her eyes grow wide with curiosity. "Tel'u! Falisha da!" *she says, as she rises to her feet, taking a few steps backwards, only to then begin to inch closer to you.* "Hanyan'el fet'u!" *she says, as she comes ever closer to you.*

*She then places her hand over her breasts.* "Iska te." *she says, patting herself on the chest.* "Te fet'u?" *she asks in a curious tone, though you can't understand what she's saying.*

"Nyan'sa..." *she says with a giggle, as she points down at your naked crotch, averting her gaze for a moment before looking back at you with a smile.*

*You have no idea who this girl is, or where you are, or maybe even... WHEN you are...*
